Players Committee card image of [[V-4X-D Ski Speeder (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E”), printing: “May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and if targeted by Force Lightning, Trample, or a weapon, may use this card's defense value instead.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f91c9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/v4xdskispeeder.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/v4xdskispeeder.gif] as of commit 0f91c9b “March 2019 Errata released” (22 March 2019).
